\rIf we ever argued, we always settled\nit with a Pokémon battle…
\rJay: Fifty years of marriage…\nMany things have happened.
\rI hope that we will continue to make\nhappy memories together.
\bJohn: Young Trainer, if the chance\narises, will you battle with us again?
\rThat silver-haired dreamboat said he was headed back to Rustboro.
\bAnd I have come to understand many things, as I suspected might happen.
\bThe honorable lady you see before you is a descendant of the ancient Draconids.
\rElder: Yes, I am one of the Draconid people.
\rOne of those ancient folk tasked passing down the knowledge of Mega Evolution--with the great lore of Lord Rayquaza, who was the beginning of all.
\rSince times long gone, Hoenn has repeatedly suffered great disasters.
\rAt times, the destruction took the form of a huge meteoroid, which fell upon our land from distant space.
\rAt other times, the Primal Reversions of our own super-ancient Pokémon brought us to the brink of destruction.
\rEach time, Lord Rayquaza has saved us from doom.
\rThe chosen Lorekeeper, standing before a stone that shone with rainbow light, offered up a wish to the great one.
\rAnd Lord Rayquaza's body was suffused with a brilliant light and transformed.
\rIn its transformed state, Rayquaza's power was more devastating than ever before, overcoming even the super-ancient Pokémon with all their primal power.
\bSteven: A rainbow-colored stone…\nAn invocation from the Lorekeeper…\nAnd a Rayquaza unlike any ever seen…
\bI see. It does resemble what we know of the process of Mega Evolution…
\bSo this is the process known as Mega Evolution…
\rA Pokémon, a person, a stone of power.\nThe bonds that tie them all together…
\rThe transformation of the Pokémon that occurs as a result of this phenomenon was called "Mega Evolution" by later peoples.
\bSteven: So the mechanism of Mega Evolution was discovered as a result of the first meeting between humanity and Rayquaza…
\rElder: The Lorekeeper is the one who has inherited the knowledge and power to summon Lord Rayquaza when disaster imperils this world.
\rThe true Lorekeeper of the current generation is the one called Zinnia.
\rThe disaster that now approaches our planet, as it has twice before…
\rZinnia has been trying for some time to avert it… in her own way.

due to the differences between storylines
\rTo waken Lord Rayquaza from its slumber, she joined a certain organization that sought to revive the super-ancient Pokémon.
\rShe taught them the secrets needed to bring back these threats and summon the great Dragon itself.
\rAnd now it seems she travels the land, scouring the world for Key Stones…
\bAs I had suspected, that woman who appeared at the Space Center was one of the Draconids…
\bBut I never dreamed she was involved in the attempted revival of the super-ancient Pokémon…
\bIn full knowledge of the power they held, fully understanding the terrible changes they would wreak upon our world…
\bDid she give a thought to the many people and Pokémon whose lives were put at grave risk by her actions?
\bCould she accept the inevitable sacrifice of so many lives, in order to protect the planet from the coming meteoroid?
\rElder: Balance must rule this world.\nHistory is doomed to repeat itself…
\rWhile our people have overcome many disasters in the past, it was always through great, great sacrifice…
\rYet we have continued to struggle to preserve peace for as many years as we can.
\rThat is how we have protected this world, upon which we now live.
\rI do not know exactly what you plan to do. But do you believe that you are not sacrificing anything for your own protection?
\rZinnia will follow her convictions until the very end.
\rEven knowing the sacrifices that they will require.
\rEven if the sacrificial blade is leveled at her own heart.
\bWhat is this…\nThis vague sense of apprehension…\nAnd my intuition has often proven true.
\bI am going back to Rustboro first.\nI have to get back to Devon.
